infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Healthy reads your steps, workouts, heart rate, HRV, sleep and body metrics to show your daily brief and track your goals — all on your phone.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Healthy writes the food you log back to Apple Health so your nutrition stays in one place.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Healthy reads your steps, workouts, heart rate, HRV, sleep and body metrics to show your daily brief and track your goals — all on your phone.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Healthy writes the food you log back to Apple Health so your nutrition stays in one place.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Healthy to use the microphone so you can talk to your coach with voice input.

extra.//: Health data now comes from the on-device stores (Android Health Connect / iOS HealthKit) — no OAuth client IDs are needed. Android health READ/WRITE permissions and the permission-rationale activity are injected by ./plugins/withHealthConnect; iOS HealthKit usage strings + entitlement by the healthkit plugin above.
